avis.titre: An honest review, this wasn't gifted/paid by the company!
avis.texte: I have dry skin & live in an area with hard water, so most hydrating products aren't strong enough to fight both the water and my dry skin. Hard water can also make bar soaps leave a waxy residue on your skin. Which makes it all the more baffling that I even tried this product in the first place. It's pretty cheap & their Anti-Breakout bar is highly rated, so I figured I'd give it a shot & if it didn't work just get my money back. I'm not lying when I say in my nearly 15 years of trying to find a hydrating face wash this is the ONLY ONE that works for me! My skin isn't terrible, so the fact I could never find a good face wash has been frustrating. I've tried drug store, name brand, knockoff, specialized, cheap, expensive, and every other kind of face wash out there, but none did what I needed. This one does everything I've been looking for at an absolute steal of a price! Any other face wash would either clean my skin or hydrate it, but never both. This one DOES! I like the smell and it cleans my skin without making it feel tight. I still use a moisturizer afterwards but the times I've skipped it my face never dried out like other face washes did. It suds really well and since it's a bar there's a ton of it. If you buy a soap saver or a tin it lasts forever! I bought this months ago and even after washing off stage makeup from theatre performances I'm only just now buying another. Everyone's skin is different but I genuinely can't believe how well this works for me. Seriously
This is super irritated to the eyes, nose, lips, mouth. Was just not meant to be used on the face. Has a super strong smell. Leaves skin feeling tight. Just overall unpleasant.

Caused allergies on my skin, and eyes there is no way to avoid the eyes if your washing your face. It's been 3 days that my eyes feel terrible. It worked on my skin for 2 'months it would clean and i felt good after that my skin would get so dry and and it would have like a slimly feel to it just like "olay" bar soaps < hate that. caused break outs that all i would use. I threw it out. I hope they make one for sensative skin and that it doesnt cause allergies to the eyes.

I was gifted by theory this cleansing bar and I'm happy I was! As someone always on the lookout for effective skincare solutions, I recently tried the Carbon Theory Superfood Cleansing Soap Bar, and I must say, it exceeded my expectations. Firstly, the packaging is sleek and environmentally friendly, which already earns points in my book. Upon opening, the bar emits a subtle, pleasant scent, not overpowering like some other products. The lather is rich and creamy, making it feel luxurious on the skin. I appreciate that it doesn't strip away moisture, leaving my skin feeling clean but not dry or tight. One of the standout features is its ability to combat blemishes and acne. The inclusion of charcoal and tea tree oil, known for their clarifying properties, helps to keep breakouts at bay without being too harsh on the skin. After consistent use, I've noticed a significant improvement in the overall texture and clarity of my skin. It feels smoother, looks brighter, and any pesky blemishes have noticeably reduced in size and redness. I also appreciate that it's suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin like mine. It's gentle yet effective, making it a staple in my skincare routine. In conclusion, the Carbon Theory Superfood Cleansing Soap Bar is a must-try for anyone looking for a gentle yet powerful cleanser that delivers results. It's a skincare gem that I'll definitely be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Squeaky Clean Feeling with a Couple Flaws
avis.texte: I was really drawn to this product because of its green ingredients. For a bar product, I'm pleasantly surprised by the amount of lather this cleanser has. While it's not as sudsy as your typical liquid cleanser, I'm still able to work the product into my skin for 1-2 minutes before rinsing off. I'm left with that 'squeaky' clean feeling without feeling stripped of moisture (though I have oily skin, so those with drier skin may have a different experience). The biggest downside for me is storage...it's much easier to stow away or travel with a bottled cleanser than it is an exposed bar of soap. I'm not sure if the purpose of the design is to minimize waste because the product still arrived in plastic packaging. Also worth noting that this WILL sting your eyes...yes, the packaging warns you of this, but as someone who likes to massage cleanser on my face for 60+ seconds, this has been a nuisance. complimentary from carbontheory

This is my first product from Carbon Theory Labs and I've never heard of them prior trying this Superfood Facial Cleansing Bar. It came in a nice reusable plastic bag, great for traveling, good size, a little bit lasts a long time. Has cucumber, kale and spinach extracts that hydrates and soothes and doesn't leave my skin tight and dry like some other cleansers. It's vegan and cruelty free

Every time I use it, my skin feels hydrated and refreshed—a testament to its quality and the results it delivers.
